verdict.rationale: CrewAI's Flows feature is explicitly described as an event-driven workflow system that lets developers connect tasks and control execution based on events/state (docs-4, docs-36, gh-1), and enterprise webhook streaming lets external events trigger actions (docs-43). Real-world community usage confirms event-based automation, e.g. using `@after_kickoff` decorators and knowledge sources to auto-trigger email drafting/Slack alerts (crewai-comm-1), showing the capability works in practice.
